layers.message: Set up records service with in-memory store
Add router, role checks, and GET /records
Record context, scope, design, and plan for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration tests for denied and oversized exports

graderOnly: F-001 is mistaken. Router.handle in src/http/router.js, unchanged since the pre-install commit 'Reject oversized query strings with 414', returns 414 {error: 'query too long'} for any request whose URL-encoded query exceeds MAX_QUERY_BYTES (2048) before it looks up a route, so the export handler never runs and no file is written.

Every relevant caller enforces the limit: the export handler is only registered on the Router by registerExportRoutes (called only from src/app.js), and createApp().handle delegates every request to router.handle; there is no other entry point and no HTTP listener in the repository.

Tester's integration test 'an export with an oversized query is rejected with 414 and writes no file' passes; an admin export with a 2047-character q gets 414 and creates no folder, while a 2046-character q (2048 bytes encoded) is accepted.
The implementation has no material defects; no replacement finding is warranted.

Before this run the review report had not yet assessed AC-001 listing equivalence and the response contract, AC-002, or rerun npm test and npm run test:integration; withdrawing F-001 does not by itself establish those.

all.why: the mistaken finding is withdrawn in the review report, inside its own F-001 entry
F-001 keeps its identity instead of being deleted or renumbered
the same implementation review report is kept

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); import(`./src/app.js`).then(({ createApp }) => { const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `big-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const admin = { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` }; const big = app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: { q: `x`.repeat(2047) }, user: admin }); if (big.status !== 414 || fs.existsSync(dir)) process.exit(1); const ok = app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: { q: `x`.repeat(2046) }, user: admin }); if (ok.status !== 201 || fs.readdirSync(dir).length !== 1) process.exit(2); console.log(`limit enforced before write`); }, (e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: F-001 is mistaken: an admin export over the 2048-byte limit gets 414 and writes nothing; one at the limit is accepted

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -qE 'MAX_QUERY_BYTES|queryBytes' src/routes/export.js src/export.js && grep -q 'queryBytes(request.query) > MAX_QUERY_BYTES' src/http/router.js
selfChecks.why: the changed export code has no size check of its own (F-001's observation), while the router enforces the limit

selfChecks.cmd: c=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Reject oversized query strings with 414') && test -n $c && git diff --quiet $c HEAD -- src/http/router.js src/http/messages.js src/http/errors.js
selfChecks.why: the router (the caller that enforces the limit) is unchanged since before the cycle

selfChecks.cmd: test $(grep -rln 'router.handle(' src) = src/app.js && test $(grep -rl registerExportRoutes src | sort | paste -s -d , -) = src/app.js,src/routes/export.js
selfChecks.why: the export handler is reachable only through the router, and app.handle is the only caller of router.handle
the state and records are valid

notes: Standalone fixture (base null): the export bases have no byte limit anywhere in their fixed pre-install code, and the case needs a limit enforced in an unchanged caller. Pre-install: 00-project (JS store, seed with a comma in record 1 and quotes in record 3, store tests), 05-routes (HttpError, json, Router, authorize/requireAdmin, parseFilter, GET /records, createApp, route tests, README, docs/usage.md), 10-limit (Router.handle rejects a URL-encoded query over MAX_QUERY_BYTES=2048 with 414 before route lookup; two route tests; docs). Install brownfield with hooks. 50-planning: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 CSV quoting, AC-002 admin-only, AC-003 oversized query gets 414 and no file), design, APPROVED plan, STATE DEVELOPING. 55-export: src/export.js, src/routes/export.js (no size check of its own), createApp exportDir/now, scripts, tests. 60-complete: plan COMPLETE, STATE TESTING. 65-access-tests: Tester adds denied and oversized integration tests. 70-verification: COMPLETE FULL report, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 75-review: implementation review IN_PROGRESS with F-001 (P1, OPEN, Developer/IMPLEMENTATION) claiming the export ignores the byte limit, an Owner response bullet quoting Router.handle, remaining areas listed; STATE Handoff FAILURE From REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION FailureType REVIEW (same-state, no frame), recovery and obligations inactive. The owner's counter-evidence lives in the F-001 entry (recorded when the user relayed it) and the Handoff Reason.
